item.title: Show HN: Generate a plan visualization with dependencies to parallelize projects
item.summary: You want to plan something big: a move, a renovation, a launch. Planning is important because it lets you parallelize independent projects. Planning is difficult because it's hard to see how every step depends on the others. This app is making planning easy by using generative AI to map the dependencies for you.
